title: Incident Report — Removal of Soft Seating (Mohammed Kaw Rasul)

field_values.incidentDescription:
Removal of Soft Seating Following an OT Assessment.

On 07/07/2026, SU Mohammed Kaw Rasul (MST/9157022) had an Occupational Therapy (OT) appointment, during which an assessment was completed.
Following the assessment, the OT recommended removing the soft chair from the SU's room to create additional space and support safe mobility.
The SU is a wheelchair user and has a profiling bed in his room.
The SU stated that he requires sufficient space to move around safely and uses either his wheelchair or profiling bed for seating.
The SU declined the soft chair, as it was not required and reduced the available space within the room.
Staff removed the soft chair in line with the OT recommendation and the SU’s preference.
The SU was informed that soft seating can be provided again at any time should his needs or preferences change.
field_values.actionTaken: Staff informed the SU that the soft seating can be provided for him at any time if he requires it in future.
